title: Fix unavailable uptime formatting
prompt:
Fix the uptime formatter in formatters.ts.
It currently displays NaNs for NaN and Infinityd NaNh for positive Infinity.

events.label: Claude
events.text: I'll start by locating the files.

events.label: Bash
events.text: List workspace and find formatter files

events.label: Read
Read
events.output:
5	for (const [label, value] of [
6	  ['NaN', Number.NaN],
7	  ['positive infinity', Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY],
8	  ['negative infinity', Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY],
9	]) {

events.label: Claude
events.text: Before: 16 pass, 2 fail (NaN and positive infinity). Applying the fix:

events.label: Edit
Bash
events.text: Run tests after fix and show diff

patch:
diff --git a/formatters.ts b/formatters.ts
index 81bb4df..44b5a58 100644
--- a/formatters.ts
+++ b/formatters.ts
@@ -22,0 +23,3 @@ export function formatUptime(valueMs: number) {
+  // NaN/±Infinity mean "unavailable" here, same as in formatBytes above: NaN
+  // fell through to "NaNs" and +Infinity to "Infinityd NaNh".
+  if (!Number.isFinite(valueMs)) return "0s";
